svg.text: The Venn Diagram Mental Model for SQL Joins
Understanding how overlapping sets create three distinct regions

text.tspan: Every SQL join selects specific combinations of these 3 regions

g.text: How Each JOIN Maps to Regions
"Show me records that exist in BOTH tables"
"Show me ALL from A + matches from B"
"Show me ALL from B + matches from A"
Query Examples Using This Mental Model:

text.tspan: INNER JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id;
LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id
LEFT JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id

svg.text: 💭 Mental Model: Think of every JOIN as selecting specific regions from the Venn diagram
